en.title: Leveraging LLMs to Translate 1993 Amiga Game’s 68000 Assembly into Godot
en.hook: Discover how LLMs can automatically convert vintage assembly code into modern game engine assets—engineers won’t want to miss this.

Building an automated pipeline to transform assembly into Godot‑compatible code
Challenges and performance considerations when porting legacy games with AI
